rows.question: Which league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH chunk_view_2 AS (
SELECT
  "Match"."league_id",
  "Match"."season",
  "Match"."home_team_goal",
  "Match"."away_team_goal",
  "Match"."id" AS "match_id"
FROM "Match"
WHERE "Match"."season" = '2015/2016'
)
SELECT League.name AS league,
       SUM(Match.home_team_goal + Match.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND Match.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
  AND Match.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY total_goals DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Which home team had lost the fewest matches in the 2016 season?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH chunk_view_2 AS (
SELECT
  id,
  season,
  match_api_id,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  home_team_goal,
  away_team_goal
FROM "Match"
WHERE season = '2015/2016'
  AND home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.team_long_name AS home_team,
       m.home_losses
FROM (
  SELECT home_team_api_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_losses
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    AND home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_team_api_id
) m
JOIN "Team" t
  ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
WHERE m.home_losses = (
  SELECT MIN(home_losses)
  FROM (
    SELECT home_team_api_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_losses
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
      AND home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
  )
)
ORDER BY m.home_losses ASC

  P.player_api_id,

  P.player_fifa_api_id,

  ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
  OR PA.player_fifa_api_id = P.player_fifa_api_id

  AND PA.date >= '2013-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND PA.date <= '2015-12-31 00:00:00'

  "Player_Attributes"."id" AS "player_attributes_id",
  "Player_Attributes"."player_api_id",
  "Player_Attributes"."sprint_speed",
  "Player_Attributes"."date",
  "Player"."player_api_id" AS "player_player_api_id",
  "Player"."birthday"
FROM "Player_Attributes"
JOIN "Player" ON "Player"."player_api_id" = "Player_Attributes"."player_api_id"
WHERE "Player_Attributes"."sprint_speed" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Player_Attributes"."date" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Player"."birthday" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Player_Attributes"."sprint_speed" >= 97

  AND "Player_Attributes"."date" <= '2015-12-31 00:00:00'
